key.name: panel-position
key.description: Which top bar box the island is placed in. Extensions that replace the top bar, such as Dash to Panel, decide where each box lands on screen.

key.name: panel-index
key.description: Position of the island inside the chosen top bar box.

key.name: always-show
key.description: Keeps the island in the top bar even when no agent session is active. When false it is hidden entirely.

key.name: permission-timeout
key.description: Seconds to wait for a decision before falling through to the agent’s own prompt. Zero waits indefinitely.

key.name: question-timeout
key.description: Seconds to wait for an answer before falling through to the agent’s own picker. Longer than the permission timeout because a question has to be read. Zero waits indefinitely.

key.name: auto-open-on-permission
key.description: Expands the popup when an agent asks for permission. Suppressed while a fullscreen window is on the primary monitor.

key.name: notification-popup
key.summary: Open the popup on a notification
key.description: Opens the popup when an agent raises a notification. Suppressed while a fullscreen window is on the primary monitor.

key.name: notification-seconds
key.description: How long the message replaces the row’s activity line, and how long a popup opened for it stays open. Zero keeps the message until the next event from that session, and never closes the popup.

key.name: enabled-agents
key.summary: Agents Dasbo Island accepts events from
key.description: Which agents Dasbo Island accepts events from. Independent of hook installation — an agent with no hooks installed never sends events.

key.name: done-linger
key.description: How long a session in the done state remains in the popup before it is dropped.

key.name: notification-sounds
key.description: Plays a sound for a permission request, an agent’s question, a notification, and a session finishing. Sounds come from the desktop’s sound theme, and stay silent when the system’s own event sounds are off.

key.name: agent-chip-display
key.description: What the tag at the head of each session row shows: the mark alone, the mark with a short name, or the name alone. A row whose mark is missing shows the name whatever this says.

key.name: welcome-shown
key.description: Set once the one-time welcome notification has been posted. Reset it to see the notification again.
